description: Geometry of salt bridges relative to pseudo-symmetry axis: three-fold matrix gate in AAC1 vs MTCH2
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
ACID={'ASP':['OD1','OD2'],'GLU':['OE1','OE2']}
BASE={'LYS':['NZ'],'ARG':['NE','NH1','NH2'],'HIS':['ND1','NE2']}
def load(fn,chain='A'):
    rows=[]
    for L in open(fn):
        if L.startswith('ATOM') and L[21]==chain:
            rows.append((int(L[22:26]),L[17:20].strip(),L[12:16].strip(),
                         float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['resi','resn','name','x','y','z'])
def axis_frame(df):
    ca=df[df.name=='CA'][['x','y','z']].values
    c=ca.mean(0); X=ca-c
    w,v=np.linalg.eigh(X.T@X); ax=v[:,np.argmax(w)]
    e1=np.cross(ax,[0,0,1.0]); e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1); e2=np.cross(ax,e1)
    return c,ax,e1,e2
def bridges(df,cut=4.0,minsep=6):
    ac=df[[ (r.resn in ACID and r.name in ACID[r.resn]) for r in df.itertuples()]]
    bs=df[[ (r.resn in BASE and r.name in BASE[r.resn]) for r in df.itertuples()]]
    A=ac[['x','y','z']].values; B=bs[['x','y','z']].values
    D=np.linalg.norm(A[:,None]-B[None],axis=2); ai,bi=np.where(D<cut)
    best={}
    for i,j in zip(ai,bi):
        ra,rb=ac.iloc[i],bs.iloc[j]
        if abs(ra.resi-rb.resi)<minsep: continue
        k=(ra.resn+str(ra.resi),rb.resn+str(rb.resi))
        if D[i,j]<best.get(k,(99,None))[0]: best[k]=(D[i,j],(A[i]+B[j])/2)
    return best

out=[]
for fn,lab in [('1OKC.pdb','AAC1 (1OKC)'),('12OY.pdb','MTCH2 (12OY)')]:
    df=load(fn); c,ax,e1,e2=axis_frame(df); bb=bridges(df)
    for (a,b),(d,mid) in bb.items():
        v=mid-c; z=float(v@ax); r=float(np.hypot(v@e1,v@e2)); th=float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(v@e2,v@e1))%360)
        out.append({'structure':lab,'pair':f'{a}-{b}','dist_A':round(d,2),'z_along_normal':round(z,1),
                    'radius_A':round(r,1),'angle_deg':round(th,0)})
T=pd.DataFrame(out).sort_values(['structure','z_along_normal'])
pd.set_option('display.width',200); print(T.to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv('saltbridge_geometry.csv',index=False)

NET=['GLU29-ARG137','ASP231-LYS32','ASP134-ARG234']
net=T[(T.structure=='AAC1 (1OKC)')&(T.pair.isin(NET))]
print('\nAAC1 matrix three-fold network geometry:'); print(net.to_string(index=False))
ang=sorted(net.angle_deg.values); print('angular separations (deg):',[round((ang[(i+1)%3]-ang[i])%360) for i in range(3)])
print('z spread (A): %.1f ; radius spread (A): %.1f'%(net.z_along_normal.max()-net.z_along_normal.min(),
                                                      net.radius_A.max()-net.radius_A.min()))
mt=T[T.structure=='MTCH2 (12OY)']
print('\nMTCH2: inter-residue salt bridges (|sep|>=6), none cluster at a common z/radius:')
print(mt.to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,5))
for axx,(lab,g) in zip(axes,T.groupby('structure')):
    isnet=g.pair.isin(NET)
    axx.scatter(g.radius_A[~isnet],g.z_along_normal[~isnet],c='#9aa0a6',s=60,label='other salt bridge')
    axx.scatter(g.radius_A[isnet],g.z_along_normal[isnet],c='#c0392b',s=110,label='matrix gate network')
    for r in g.itertuples(): axx.annotate(r.pair,(r.radius_A,r.z_along_normal),fontsize=6,xytext=(3,3),textcoords='offset points')
    axx.axhspan(-15,15,color='#f0e6d2',zorder=0)
    axx.set_title(lab,fontsize=11); axx.set_xlabel('radius from pseudo-symmetry axis (A)')
    axx.set_ylabel('position along membrane normal (A)'); axx.legend(fontsize=7)
plt.suptitle('Salt-bridge geometry: AAC1 has a closed three-fold matrix gate; MTCH2 has none',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
